# FP Jargon

> Interactive functional programming knowledge graph and specification exploring 57 concepts, category theory morphisms, and algebraic structures with JavaScript ES2015 examples.

FP Jargon maps out the entire vocabulary of functional programming into an interconnected graph with deterministic explanations, formal properties, and executable JavaScript examples.

## Links

- [Interactive Knowledge Graph](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/): The live interactive application
- [Full Text Specification (llms-full.txt)](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/llms-full.txt): Complete catalog with all definitions and code blocks
- [Raw JSON Dataset](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/data/jargons.json): Structured JSON dataset of terms, categories, and graph edges
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/hemanth/functional-programming-jargon): Source code and collaborative community specification
- [Author](https://h3manth.com): Hemanth HM

## Categories & Concepts

### Core Functions
- [Function](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#function): Pure expression with one immutable parameter and deterministic return value.
- [Pure Function](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#pure-function): Deterministic function without side effects or hidden dependencies.
- [Higher-Order Functions (HOF)](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#higher-order-functions-hof): Functions that take or return other functions.
- [Closure](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#closure): Scope capturing local variables for retained access.
- [Lambda](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#lambda): Anonymous arrow function treated as a first-class value.
- [Arity](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#arity): Number of arguments a function takes (unary, binary, ternary, variadic).
- [Predicate](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#predicate): Function returning a boolean truth value.
- [Total Function](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#total-function): Function defined and valid for all possible inputs in its domain.
- [Partial Function](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#partial-function): Function not defined for all arguments.
- [Dealing with Partial Functions](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#dealing-with-partial-functions): Converting partial functions to total functions using guards, defaults, or Option types.

### Composition & Flow
- [Function Composition](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#function-composition): Putting two functions together where output of one is input of the other.
- [Currying](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#currying): Translating a function of multiple arguments into a chain of unary functions.
- [Auto-Currying](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#auto-currying): Currying that evaluates as soon as the expected argument count is supplied.
- [Partial Application](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#partial-application): Pre-filling some arguments of a function to produce a new function of smaller arity.
- [Point-Free Style](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#point-free-style): Tacit programming where function definitions omit explicit argument names.
- [Functional Combinator](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#functional-combinator): Higher-order function that combines existing functions purely through combinatory logic.
- [Continuation](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#continuation): Suspended computation representing the rest of a program execution.
- [Lazy Evaluation](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#lazy-evaluation): Call-by-need mechanism delaying evaluation until a value is strictly required.

### Purity & Reasoning
- [Side Effects](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#side-effects): Any state modification or external interaction outside the returned value.
- [Referential Transparency](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#referential-transparency): Property where an expression can always be substituted by its evaluated value.
- [Equational Reasoning](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#equational-reasoning): Ability to prove code correctness through algebraic substitution.
- [Idempotence](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#idempotence): Operation that produces identical results regardless of repeated executions.
- [Value](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#value): Immutable piece of data assigned to a variable or evaluated from an expression.
- [Constant](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#constant): Variable that cannot be re-assigned or mutated after declaration.
- [Constant Function](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#constant-function): Function that always returns the same value regardless of inputs.
- [Contracts](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#contracts): Runtime assertions verifying obligations, preconditions, and postconditions.

### Category Theory & Morphisms
- [Category](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#category): Collection of objects and composable morphisms satisfying identity and associativity laws.
- [Morphism](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#morphism): Structure-preserving map or transformation between objects.
- [Homomorphism](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#homomorphism): Transformation preserving designated algebraic structure between source and target.
- [Endomorphism](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#endomorphism): Morphism where the source type equals the destination type.
- [Isomorphism](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#isomorphism): Bijective morphism with a two-way invertible mapping.
- [Catamorphism](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#catamorphism): Morphism that deconstructs a recursive structure into a single summary value (reduce, fold).
- [Anamorphism](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#anamorphism): Morphism that builds up a recursive structure from a seed value (unfold).
- [Hylomorphism](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#hylomorphism): Composition of an anamorphism followed by a catamorphism (unfold-then-fold).
- [Paramorphism](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#paramorphism): Fold with access to intermediate sub-computations and structural history.
- [Apomorphism](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#apomorphism): Unfold with early termination capabilities.

### Algebraic Structures
- [Setoid](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#setoid): Object implementing an equivalence relation with an equals method.
- [Semigroup](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#semigroup): Structure with an associative binary concat operation.
- [Monoid](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#monoid): Semigroup equipped with an identity element (empty).
- [Functor](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#functor): Object implementing map preserving identity and composition.
- [Pointed Functor](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#pointed-functor): Functor with an of constructor to lift arbitrary values.
- [Applicative Functor](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#applicative-functor): Functor with an ap function to apply wrapped functions to wrapped values.
- [Monad](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#monad): Pointed applicative functor with chain / flatMap / bind to flatten nested contexts.
- [Comonad](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#comonad): Dual of a monad with extract and extend.
- [Foldable](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#foldable): Structure that can be reduced into a summary value using reduce.
- [Kleisli Composition](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#kleisli-composition): Composition operator chaining monad-returning functions.
- [Lift](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#lift): Promoting a function or value into an applicative context.
- [Constant Functor](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#constant-functor): Functor that ignores mapping operations, preserving fixed initial state.
- [Constant Monad](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#constant-monad): Monad that discards chaining computations.

### Types & Modeling
- [Type Signatures](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#type-signatures): Formal notation documenting argument and return types.
- [Algebraic Data Type (ADT)](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#algebraic-data-type): Composite type formed by combining other types via sums and products.
- [Sum Type](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#sum-type): Disjoint union representation containing exactly one of multiple tagged variants.
- [Product Type](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#product-type): Compound structure combining fields where total space is the product of field spaces.
- [Option](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#option): Sum type representing presence (Some) or absence (None) of a value.
- [Lens](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#lens): Composable functional optic pairing a getter and immutable setter for nested data.
- [Lambda Calculus](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#lambda-calculus): Formal mathematical foundation of computation based on function abstraction and application.
- [Functional Programming Libraries in JavaScript](https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/#functional-programming-libraries-in-javascript): Curated ecosystem catalog (Ramda, Folktale, Sanctuary, fp-ts, Crocks, Immer).

## Agent & LLM Usage

AI agents can directly query or ingest this dataset via:

- Raw JSON Graph API: `https://hemanth.github.io/functional-programming-jargon/data/jargons.json`
